name: 2x2_lattice_mask_v1
semantics: Binary uint8 PNG. White (255) selects lattice; black (0) preserves image.
note: User-painted initial mask for the 2x2 lattice, preserved byte-for-byte without smoothing or other pixel edits. All annotation is in near; far and reflection remain empty. The combined mask is the union of included layers. This is a separate sensor layout, not a replacement for the five-cell masks. Use only with matching lattice, camera pose, crop and initial undeformed state.
